document.name: CCTV & Security Setup
document.description: Protect your home or office with our professional CCTV installation. We supply and install HD cameras, NVR/DVR systems, and configure remote viewing on your phone.

document.name: False Ceiling Design & Installation
document.description: From POP to gypsum board, we design and install stunning false ceilings with integrated LED cove lighting, downlights, and custom patterns.

document.name: Interior Painting
document.description: Give your home a fresh look with our professional interior painting service. We use premium zero-VOC paints with thorough surface prep, crack filling, and two coats of finish.

document.name: Smart Home Installation
document.description: Our certified technicians will design and install a complete smart home system tailored to your lifestyle. From smart lighting to security cameras and voice control — we handle everything.

document.name: Flooring Installation
document.description: We supply and install premium flooring solutions including SPC vinyl, LVT planks, laminate, and engineered hardwood. Old floor removal and surface prep included.
